AestheticEye is your premier destination for advanced face and eye plastic surgery and cosmetic procedures in Cincinnati, OH. Our board-certified oculoplastic surgeons, Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament, specialize in enhancing your natural beauty and addressing a variety of ocular and facial conditions. With their extensive training and compassionate approach, you can trust that you are in expert hands.

Excellence in Plastic and Reconstructive Procedures for the Eyes

At AestheticEye, we are dedicated to providing exceptional care through our comprehensive range of plastic and reconstructive procedures for the eyes. Our team of expert surgeons employs the latest techniques and state-of-the-art technology to ensure the best possible outcomes for our patients. Whether you are looking to rejuvenate your appearance or require reconstructive surgery for medical reasons, we are committed to delivering results that enhance both form and function.

Our specialized procedures cover a wide spectrum of surgical and non-surgical treatments designed to meet your unique needs and goals. These include:

  • Blepharoplasty (Lower Eyelid Surgery)
  • Blepharoplasty (Upper Eyelid Surgery)
  • Brow Lift & Forehead Lift
  • Cosmetic Eyelid Surgery
  • Fat Transfer Surgery
  • Lower Eyelid Bags
  • Male Blepharoplasty

Trust Your Eyes to an Expert

Meet Dr. Ginger Henson

Dr. Ginger Henson is a board-certified oculoplastic surgeon with a passion for helping patients achieve their aesthetic and functional goals. With her extensive training in oculofacial plastic and reconstructive surgery, Dr. Henson is adept at performing a variety of procedures, from cosmetic enhancements to complex reconstructive surgeries. Her meticulous attention to detail and compassionate care make her a trusted choice for patients seeking the best in eye and facial surgery.

Meet Dr. Jonathan Pargament

Dr. Jonathan Pargament is a highly skilled oculoplastic surgeon who brings a wealth of expertise to AestheticEye. Specializing in advanced surgical techniques for eyelid and facial reconstruction, Dr. Pargament is dedicated to providing exceptional care with a focus on achieving natural-looking results. His patient-centered approach ensures that each individual receives the personalized attention they deserve, making him a leading expert in the field.
